item.text:
Created a Rust 2021 project in `/output` with the root entry file [test11.rs](/output/test11.rs) and modular library code in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/atoi.rs](/output/src/atoi.rs), [src/geometry.rs](/output/src/geometry.rs), and [src/triangulation.rs](/output/src/triangulation.rs). It uses only `std`, parses args via `std::env::args()`, preserves `atoi`-style parsing behavior for inputs like `abc`, `3x`, and `+4`, and prints the index stream with the same trailing spaces and no newline.

Builds succeeded with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc test11.rs -O -o /output/test11_rustc`. I verified the Cargo binary against `/workspace/dataset/test11_executable` for default execution plus `0, 1, 2, 3, ..., 20, abc, 3x, +4, 0011, -1, -5`, and the output matched byte-for-byte. The built executables are [test11](/output/target/release/test11) and [test11_rustc](/output/test11_rustc).
